 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Ahead of World Series Game 5 on Wednesday night, Oct. 28, Fox Sports pregame show analysts split between the Tampa Bay Rays and Milwaukee Brewers again for the last game of the best-of-seven Series in Tropicana Field in St. Petersburg, Florida.
 Derek Jeter: Brewers win, 6-2
 David Ortiz: Rays win, 4-2
 Alex Rodriguez: Rays win, 5-3
 Jeter cited a conversation he overheard with Brewers first baseman Jake Bauers on bringing back momentum and cleaning up the Series, which won him over.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Ortiz didn't make any further analysis besides sticking with the team he's chosen in every pregame panel this series.
 Fox TV analyst Alex Rodriguez listens as David Ortiz talks during pregame before Game 4 of the World Series at Tropicana Field in St. Petersburg, Fla. on Oct 27, 2026. - Jovanny Hernandez / Milwaukee Journal Sentinel Rodriguez, short on time, simply backed the Rays because Ortiz had, making a joke about how they've already been roommates in Florida as the Series continues.
 The analysts' predictions have been hit-and-miss. The full trio picked the Rays to win Game 3, which could not have ended less true , and split, 2-1, for the Rays to win Game 4, which did come true .
 It isn't the first time Jeter broke away from his fellow panelists for the Brewers. He thought the Brewers could complete the sweep by Game 4 in a 6-1 victory.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement At the start of the series , Jeter picked the Brewers to win the whole series in seven games, Ortiz had Rays in seven and Rodriguez had the Brewers in seven.
